translation: However, those of later generations who discuss wasting-thirst mostly do not know its root. They say that in wasting-thirst, the upper [part] is replete-heat and the lower [part] is vacuous-cold; because the upper is hot, there is vexing thirst and much drinking; because the lower is cold, there is much urination. It is originally because the kidney water of the lower part is vacuous and cannot control the heart fire of the upper burner, hence the upper is replete-heat and the lower is vacuous-cold.
